en.text:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.

Scoring hits with the gun grants 10% Healing Charge. (Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.)

Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds restore 30 HP per hit and do not consume ammo, instead costing 2% Healing Charge each. Firing a healing round <title refills [G_refills] /> 2 rounds into the magazine from reserves.

Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each spawns a <strand/>Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases weapon damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.

Healing a <yellow Teeming Nest /> also grants you the Support Frame Boost.
